title_en: Every Rubik's Cube Can Be Solved in 20 Moves #Shorts
desc_en:
A Rubik's Cube has 43,252,003,274,489,856,000 possible states. In 2010 a team proved that every one of them can be solved in 20 moves or fewer, using about 35 years of computer time donated by Google.

Sources: cube20.org; MAA; Popular Science.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
